entities.name: PMID:25076543
observations: Retrospective single-center cohort of 196 patients undergoing mitral-aortic double valve replacement; aortic PPM was defined as EOAI ≤0.85 cm²/m² and occurred in 28.1%.
In-hospital mortality was 16.4% with aortic PPM versus 2.8% without PPM; overall cohort mortality was 6.63%.
Aortic PPM was associated with higher overall and cardiac postoperative complications and longer ICU stay.
Multivariable models retained PPM and age for hospital mortality, and PPM, age, and bypass time for postoperative complications; adjusted effect sizes were not reported in the abstract.
The study combined moderate and severe PPM and did not report separate severity-specific results.

entities.name: DVR aortic PPM mortality
observations: In 196 mitral-aortic double valve replacements, in-hospital mortality was 16.4% with aortic PPM versus 2.8% without PPM, an absolute difference of 13.6 percentage points and approximate unadjusted risk ratio of 5.9.

entities.name: DVR aortic PPM morbidity
observations: Aortic PPM after double valve replacement was associated with more overall complications, more cardiac complications, and longer ICU stay; numerical rates and durations were not provided in the abstract.
